title: Developer
description: Where the code spends its time: engine stages, record() cost, traces, and what lands in each table.

panels.title: Engine stages per tick (µs)

targets.rawSql: SELECT replaceOne(app, 'engine-', '') AS engine, labels['stage'] AS stage, round(min(min) / 1e3, 3) AS min, round(sum(p50 * count) / sum(count) / 1e3, 3) AS p50, round(sum(p99 * count) / sum(count) / 1e3, 3) AS p99, round(sum(p9999 * count) / sum(count) / 1e3, 3) AS p99_99, round(max(max) / 1e3, 3) AS max, sum(count) AS samples FROM metrics.metrics_histogram WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'trace_ns' AND labels['trace'] = 'tick_to_trade' AND labels['stage'] IN ('decode', 'book', 'signal', 'decide', 'send') GROUP BY engine, stage ORDER BY engine, stage

panels.description: Stage costs on the engine thread: decode the SBE message, apply it to the book, the EMAs (signal), the strategy (decide), the order (send). Count-weighted averages of each 5 s window's estimated percentiles (not percentiles of all samples combined); min and max are exact. Cross-node values use both nodes' wall clocks.

panels.title: Engine stages over time: min, p50, p99, p99.99, max (µs)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, concat(replaceOne(app, 'engine-', ''), ' ', labels['stage']) AS series, min(min) / 1e3 AS min, sum(p50 * count) / sum(count) / 1e3 AS p50, sum(p99 * count) / sum(count) / 1e3 AS p99, sum(p9999 * count) / sum(count) / 1e3 AS p99_99, max(max) / 1e3 AS max FROM metrics.metrics_histogram WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'trace_ns' AND labels['trace'] = 'tick_to_trade' AND labels['stage'] IN ('decode', 'book', 'signal', 'decide', 'send') GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.title: Tick to order, ticks that sent one (µs)

targets.rawSql: SELECT replaceOne(app, 'engine-', '') AS engine, concat(labels['venue'], ' (', labels['from'], ')') AS tick_from, round(min(min) / 1e3, 3) AS min, round(sum(p50 * count) / sum(count) / 1e3, 3) AS p50, round(sum(p99 * count) / sum(count) / 1e3, 3) AS p99, round(sum(p9999 * count) / sum(count) / 1e3, 3) AS p99_99, round(max(max) / 1e3, 3) AS max, sum(count) AS samples FROM metrics.metrics_histogram WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'tick_to_order_ns' GROUP BY engine, tick_from ORDER BY engine, tick_from

panels.description: Count-weighted averages of each 5 s window's estimated percentiles (not percentiles of all samples combined); min and max are exact. Cross-node values use both nodes' wall clocks.

panels.title: record() per trade (µs)

targets.rawSql: SELECT app, round(min(min) / 1e3, 3) AS min, round(sum(p50 * count) / sum(count) / 1e3, 3) AS p50, round(sum(p99 * count) / sum(count) / 1e3, 3) AS p99, round(sum(p9999 * count) / sum(count) / 1e3, 3) AS p99_99, round(max(max) / 1e3, 3) AS max, sum(count) AS samples FROM metrics.metrics_histogram WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'record_ns' GROUP BY app ORDER BY app

panels.description: runtime::persist::record of one trade on the feed handler's thread: the cost of recording on the hot path. Count-weighted averages of each 5 s window's estimated percentiles (not percentiles of all samples combined); min and max are exact. Cross-node values use both nodes' wall clocks.

panels.title: Trace stages clamped / s (a stage ended before it started: clocks)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, concat(app, ' ', labels['trace'], ' ', labels['stage']) AS series, sum(delta) / $__interval_s AS rate FROM metrics.metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'trace_clamped' GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.title: Slowest kept tick-to-trade traces (open one in Traces)

targets.rawSql: SELECT Timestamp, TraceId, ServiceName, round(Duration / 1e3) AS us FROM tracing.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ParentSpanId = '' AND SpanName = 'tick_to_trade' ORDER BY Duration DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS time, database || '.' || table AS t, sum(rows) / $__interval_s AS rows FROM system.part_log WHERE database IN ('md', 'engine', 'orders', 'tracing', 'metrics') AND event_type = 'NewPart' AND $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY time, t ORDER BY time

SELECT event_time, user, substring(query, 1, 200) AS ddl FROM system.query_log WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND query_kind IN ('Create', 'Alter') AND event_time > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND query NOT LIKE '%system.%' ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 50
